description: How an agent reviews an existing chart or dashboard and proposes improvements. Contains the review steps, the severity mapping, the order to triage findings, a symptom to fix playbook for the most common upgrades. Findings follow data/review-output.schema.json. Every rule id here is defined in data/dataviz-rules.json; this file never restates rule text, so the two can't drift.

verdicts.WARN: A recommended rule is not met. Note it and offer the fix
verdicts.FAIL: A required rule is not met. Fix before handoff

triage_note: Report in this order: things that exclude people or mislead come first, polish last. Within a category, FAIL before WARN.

review_steps.name: Inventory
review_steps.action: List every visualization on the screen: tiles, charts, tables with sparklines, maps. Give each a stable local id (V1, V2...). Note the page template (DASH-Q-TYPE) and the audience.

review_steps.name: Infer the job
review_steps.action: For each item write the question it appears to answer and its job from data/decision-tree.json 'jobs'. If you can't, that is a DV-PURPOSE-001 finding.

review_steps.name: Check the form
review_steps.action: Walk the tree for that job. Compare the form used with the tree's results and alternatives. A form outside the reachable set is a DV-FORM-001 finding; name the better form.

review_steps.name: Run the mechanical checks
review_steps.action: If you have code, run scripts/detect.mjs on the files and fold the output in. If you have a spec, run scripts/check-spec.mjs. These cover the 'auto' and 'spec' rules.

review_steps.name: Run the judgment checks
review_steps.action: For each remaining rule with enforcement 'judgment', look at the render and decide PASS, WARN or FAIL. Start with DV-A11Y and DV-HONEST. Don't skip a category because the detectors were clean.

review_steps.name: Check the dashboard as a whole
review_steps.action: Check the page: hierarchy (DV-LAYOUT-001), one filter row (DV-FILTER-001), consistent periods and colors (DV-CONSIST-*), the state matrix for every card (DASH-STATE-MATRIX).

review_steps.name: Propose the upgrade
review_steps.action: For every FAIL and every WARN you'd fix, give the concrete change: the rule's 'do', the replacement form, and the component names. Prefer the playbook below when a symptom matches. Don't redesign what passes.

review_steps.name: Report
review_steps.action: Emit findings in the output schema, ordered by triage_order, then a one-paragraph summary: what's strongest, what to fix first. Call vois_record_rule_usage for the rule ids that drove changes.

improvement_playbook.symptom: Pie or donut with more than 6 slices, or close values
improvement_playbook.fix: Sorted horizontal bar, top 10 plus Other, values at the bar end. Keep a donut only for 3 to 6 parts with the total in the hole.

improvement_playbook.symptom: Two y-axes on one chart
improvement_playbook.fix: Split into two aligned charts sharing the x-axis, or index both to 100 at the first period on one axis.

improvement_playbook.symptom: Bar axis doesn't start at zero
improvement_playbook.fix: Set the domain to start at 0. If the change is small, show the delta as a number or switch to a line and say the axis is zoomed.

improvement_playbook.symptom: Curved, smoothed line that overshoots
improvement_playbook.fix: Use monotone or linear. Use step for values that hold between events.

improvement_playbook.symptom: Each bar of one series has its own color
improvement_playbook.fix: One color for every bar. Use text labels for status, or an ordinal ramp if the bars are ordered stages.

improvement_playbook.symptom: More than 8 series or a '+N more' legend
improvement_playbook.fix: Top 8 plus Other, or emphasis (one accent, rest gray), or small multiples. Add a table for the long tail.

improvement_playbook.symptom: Red and green are the only cue
improvement_playbook.fix: Add an arrow, a sign or a label. Use the diverging pair (warm and cool) instead of red and green where the meaning isn't good versus bad.

improvement_playbook.symptom: KPI with no comparison
improvement_playbook.fix: Add a delta chip against a named period, and a sparkline if the trend matters.

improvement_playbook.symptom: Date picker is calendar-only
improvement_playbook.fix: Presets first (Today, 7, 30, 90 days, This month, Year to date), custom behind them, comparison control beside, timezone shown.

improvement_playbook.symptom: Each card has its own filter or range
improvement_playbook.fix: Hoist to one filter row above the cards. Mark and allow reset for any deliberate local override.

improvement_playbook.symptom: Full-page spinner or skeleton flash on every filter change
improvement_playbook.fix: Skeleton on first load in the final geometry; on refetch hold the previous render at reduced opacity.

improvement_playbook.symptom: A row of flat zero charts
improvement_playbook.fix: One collecting-data or no-activity state that explains the threshold. Don't draw axes for nothing.

improvement_playbook.symptom: Number on every point
improvement_playbook.fix: Label the end and the extreme only. Put the rest in the tooltip and table.

improvement_playbook.symptom: Tooltip is the only way to read values
improvement_playbook.fix: Direct-label the points that matter and add a Chart | Table toggle. Make the tooltip appear on focus.

improvement_playbook.symptom: No text alternative or table view
improvement_playbook.fix: Wrap in a figure with a caption, add accessibilityLayer, and a table view fed by the same config.

improvement_playbook.symptom: Funnel with a color per stage or a step over 100%
improvement_playbook.fix: One-hue ordinal ramp; show counts with the percent and suppress or flag ratios on tiny denominators.

improvement_playbook.symptom: Overlapping translucent areas in similar hues
improvement_playbook.fix: Stack them, facet them, or cut to two with a 10 to 15 percent wash.

improvement_playbook.symptom: Hex colors in chart code
improvement_playbook.fix: Move colors into the chart config as var(--chart-N) tokens, keyed by series.

improvement_playbook.symptom: Chart-type picker with a dozen or more tiles
improvement_playbook.fix: Offer 5 valid types for the data shape and disable the rest with a reason.

improvement_playbook.symptom: Decorative gradient, 3D or heavy borders
improvement_playbook.fix: Flat marks, hairline grid, wash fill at about 10 percent.

report_template:
## Data viz review: <screen>

**Audience:** <executive|analyst|operator|general> · **Template:** <DASH-*> · **Visualizations:** <n>

### Summary
<One paragraph: what works, the top 3 fixes.>

### Findings (FAIL first)
| # | Viz | Rule | Verdict | What's wrong | Fix |
|---|-----|------|---------|--------------|-----|

### Proposed changes
<Concrete changes with form ids, component names and token roles.>

### Not checked
<Anything you couldn't verify, e.g. contrast without rendered colors.>
